from sqlalchemy import select
from gridlens.jobs.worker import run_one, sync_registry
from gridlens.persistence.database import SessionLocal
from gridlens.persistence.models import Job
definitions = {item['id']: item for item in sync_registry()}
with SessionLocal() as session:
    job = session.scalar(select(Job).where(Job.kind == 'pursuit_research', Job.status == 'queued').order_by(Job.created_at).limit(1))
job_id = job.id if job else None
print({'queued_job': str(job_id) if job_id else None, 'ran': run_one(definitions, job_ids=[job_id]) if job_id else False})
